SELECT add_provenance('lineitem');
SELECT set_prob(provenance(), prob) FROM lineitem;
CREATE VIEW revenue AS SELECT DISTINCT t0.c4 AS c1 FROM lineitem t0 WHERE t0.c9 >= 19960101 AND t0.c9 < 19960401;
CREATE VIEW q15 AS SELECT DISTINCT 1 AS c1 FROM supplier t0, revenue t1 WHERE t1.c1 = t0.c1;
